dct_description_sm: Vanuatu administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 6 nan - Admin 2: 66 nan Dates associated with this dataset: - 31 October 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 24 August 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 31 October 2017: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 31 October 2017: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Office of the Pacific Islands](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rop). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: PopGIS2: Secretarial of the Pacific Community (SPC), Statistics for Development Division (http://vanuatu.popgis.spc.int/#l=en;v=map4)
